verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an official Terraform provider or any equivalent declarative, reviewable config-as-code tool for Okta apps, groups, or policies. The MCP server offers natural-language admin operations and SCIM covers provisioning APIs. Both are adjacent features, not reproducible infrastructure-as-code, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the IdP is managed as code — an official Terraform provider (or equivalent) covers apps, groups, and policies so identity config is reviewable and reproducible
